capstones.name: Warlord's Tenacity
capstones.effect: For 30 rounds, max HP +20%, melee mitigation +15%, immune to fear.
capstones.description: The warlord endures what would break lesser warriors.

capstones.name: Marr's Salvation
capstones.effect: Heal group for 50% of max HP and cure all detrimental effects. Cannot be interrupted.
capstones.description: Mithaniel Marr's blessing washes over the faithful.

capstones.name: Visage of Death
capstones.effect: For 20 rounds, take on a deathly visage: +25% lifetap effectiveness, +15% melee damage, fear immunity.
capstones.description: The shadowknight wears death itself as a mask.

capstones.name: Ironfist
capstones.effect: For 20 rounds, fist damage +40%, chance to stun on hit +10%.
capstones.description: The monk's fists become as iron.

capstones.name: Rogue's Fury
capstones.effect: For 15 rounds, +35% melee damage, +20% accuracy, +10% crit chance.

capstones.name: Juggernaut Surge
capstones.effect: For 15 rounds, +50% melee damage, immune to stun, cannot be slowed. Take +10% damage.
capstones.description: The berserker becomes an unstoppable juggernaut.

capstones.name: Auspice of the Hunter
capstones.effect: Group buff (50 rounds): +20% crit chance, +15% accuracy, +10% damage.
capstones.description: The ranger invokes the hunter's auspice over the group.

capstones.name: Frenzy of Spirit
capstones.effect: For 15 rounds, beastlord attack speed +40%, warder damage +50%.
capstones.description: Spirit frenzy consumes both master and warder.

capstones.name: Quick Time
capstones.effect: For 15 rounds, group gains +30% spell haste, +20% melee haste, +15% damage.
capstones.description: The bard quickens time itself for the group.

capstones.name: Divine Arbitration
capstones.effect: Balance the group's HP: all members set to the average HP%. If below 50%, heal group to 50%.
capstones.description: Divine judgment balances the scales of life.

capstones.name: Nature's Fury
capstones.effect: For 20 rounds, spell damage +40%, mana cost -20%.
capstones.description: Nature's fury flows through the druid.

capstones.name: Spirit of the Rhino
capstones.effect: Group buff (100 rounds): +30% melee damage, +200 HP, knockback resistance.
capstones.description: The rhino spirit's strength fills the group.

capstones.name: Mind Crash
capstones.effect: Memory blur all enemies (50% chance per target to forget the enchanter).
capstones.description: The enchanter crashes the minds of enemies, erasing their anger.

capstones.name: Elemental Union
capstones.effect: For 20 rounds, magician and pet both gain +35% damage, pet takes -25% damage.
capstones.description: Caster and elemental fight in perfect union.

capstones.name: Swarm of Decay
capstones.effect: Summon 6 disease-based swarm pets for 8 rounds. Each applies a stacking DoT.
capstones.description: Decay given form swarms the enemy.

mechanics.description: Summons 6 disease-based swarm pets for 45 seconds. Each applies a stacking disease DoT.

capstones.name: Frenzied Devastation
capstones.effect: For 15 rounds, spell crit chance +30%, crit damage +50%.
